injuries.name: Bo Bichette
injuries.note: Day-To-Day: Bichette (leg/ankle) is out of the lineup for Sunday's game against the Red Sox.

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: 60-Day-IL: Ragans underwent UCL repair surgery on his left elbow Wednesday, Anne Rogers of MLB.com reports.

injuries.name: Chase Burns
injuries.note: Day-To-Day: Burns will not play in Tuesday's All-Star Game due to a right groin injury he suffered during his last start Wednesday, Mark Sheldon of MLB.com reports.
